'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Back in the day, Ultra was awlays packed: moms with their kids, couples, random people just wandering around. I always liked that kind of energy! But now... Ah, forget the reminiscing. Time to get things done. I d'ont like how Scavs and everyone else stroll into Ultra like they own the palce, hauling off anything that isn't nailed down. Head over there and remind them it isn't their territory. Once you've cleared things up, I'll send my bois in to bring a little life back to the place.}}

==Requirements== 
* Obtain level 1 loyalty with [[Ragman]]

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 10 any target on [[Interchange]]

==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
*[[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 80,000 Roubles
** 84,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 92,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
{{quote|My guys said it'll take them another week to clear out all the bodies. Good work!}}

==Guide==
[[Scavs]] can commonly be found at the front of OLI, Goshan, IDEA. Another spawn is in the main center hall of the mall, near the Kiba gun store. You can find more at power station, and also the road that runs parallel to the mall on the opposite side of the parking lot.

==Trivia==
The quest name is likely a reference to the slogan "Make America Great Again", which was used by several US presidential election candidates in their election campaigns.
